from pathlib import Path

import re
from openpyxl import load_workbook

spreadsheet_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/5192/1_5192_input.xlsx"

wb = load_workbook(spreadsheet_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"]

# Also load cached/displayed values in case the worked example is stored as a formula.
try:
    wb_vals = load_workbook(spreadsheet_path, data_only=True)
    ws_vals = wb_vals["Sheet1"]
except Exception:
    ws_vals = None

def as_text(v):
    if v is None:
        return ""
    return v if isinstance(v, str) else str(v)

def transform_include_separator(v):
    """Move the last digit-run to the beginning, keeping all surrounding text."""
    s = as_text(v)
    matches = list(re.finditer(r"\d+", s))
    if not matches:
        return s
    m = matches[-1]
    return m.group(0) + s[:m.start()] + s[m.end():]

def transform_drop_separator(v):
    """
    Match the workbook's shown pattern: move the final digit-run to the beginning
    and omit the immediately preceding non-digit separator character.
    Example: CH02A1456 -> 1456CH02
    """
    s = as_text(v)
    matches = list(re.finditer(r"\d+", s))
    if not matches:
        return s
    m = matches[-1]
    before = s[:m.start()]
    after = s[m.end():]
    if before and not before[-1].isdigit():
        before = before[:-1]
    return m.group(0) + before + after

# Infer the intended pattern from the existing worked example in B2 when present.
existing_b2 = ws["B2"].value
if isinstance(existing_b2, str) and existing_b2.startswith("=") and ws_vals is not None:
    existing_b2 = ws_vals["B2"].value

a2 = ws["A2"].value
if existing_b2 == transform_include_separator(a2):
    mode = "include"
else:
    # The previewed workbook's worked example matches this pattern.
    mode = "drop"

# Preserve the visible style pattern from the worked example cell inside the allowed range.
style_source = ws["B2"]

for row in range(2, 5):
    cell = ws[f"B{row}"]
    if mode == "include":
        cell.value = transform_include_separator(ws[f"A{row}"].value)
    else:
        cell.value = transform_drop_separator(ws[f"A{row}"].value)

    if row != 2:
        cell._style = copy(style_source._style)
        cell.number_format = style_source.number_format
        cell.font = copy(style_source.font)
        cell.fill = copy(style_source.fill)
        cell.border = copy(style_source.border)
        cell.alignment = copy(style_source.alignment)
        cell.protection = copy(style_source.protection)

Path(output_path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
